theorems.name: Submission.rsd_tendsto_closedBall_density_of_approxTangent
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (M : Set (Euclid P)) (x : Euclid P) (Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (s : ℝ), 0 < s → μHE[n] (M ∩ closedBall x s) ≠ ∞ → HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M x Q → Tendsto (fun ρ : ℝ => μHE[n] (M ∩ closedBall x ρ) / (unitBallVolume n * ENNReal.ofReal (ρ ^ n))) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 1)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
